title: 153 Union Street E (Z-26-11)
body:
153 Union Street E
Changes to the Zoning Bylaw for this location are required before a permit can be issued. This means the owner must submit an application that is reviewed by city planners and other agencies plus city council before anything can be built.
Southside Construction Management Limited is proposing to build two new buildings at 153 Union St E. Building A is proposed to be 11 storeys with 321 sqm of commercial area and Building B is proposed to be 12 storeys.
Zoning bylaw changes requested include:
Rezone the lands from holding Mixed-Use Neighbourhood Commercial ((H)C2-40) to Mixed Use Community
Commercial (C1-40)
Permit residential uses on the ground floor
Permit
a reduced side yard setback for the exposed underground parking garage of 0.95m
Permit a reduced
tower separation of 5m for Building B and 0.95m for Building A
Permit a maximum
horizontal tower dimension of 51m for Building A
Permit
a maximum tower footprint of 1,200 sq.m for Building A
Require
a minimum of 320 sqm of commercial building floor area on the lands
View the documents submitted by the development company under supporting documents on this page for more details and drawings.
Building height, units, housing types
Tallest tower: Building A - 11 storeys, Building B - 12 storeys
Number of units: 244 units with 356 beds
Unit sizes: mix of one and two bedrooms
Housing types: apartments
Non-residential floor space
Commercial space: 321 sqm
Parking
Parking: 324 parking spaces (surface and underground)
Bicycle parking: 152
You can provide feedback to the planning department, and it will be shared with the council, or ask a question to learn more about this application.
Images are provided by the applicant and may not reflect the final design approved by the planning division.
